details.formulaDescription: dailyLowGrams = round(bodyMassKg × 10); dailyHighGrams = round(bodyMassKg × 12). windowTotalLowGrams = round(dailyLowGrams × loadWindowHours / 24); windowTotalHighGrams = round(dailyHighGrams × loadWindowHours / 24). indicated = eventDurationMinutes > 90. The 10–12 g/kg/day range and the 36–48 hour window come from the 2016 ACSM joint position statement; the arithmetic simply scales the range to the entered body mass and window.
assumptions: The dose range applies to sustained or intermittent exercise longer than 90 minutes; shorter events are flagged as not indicated.
The tool reports the published 10–12 g/kg/day range as a planning band, not a personal prescription.
Carbohydrate quality, meal splitting, gut tolerance and food preferences are outside the calculation.
The tool does not account for diabetes, eating disorders, pregnancy, gastrointestinal disease or other medical conditions.
The window is a 36–48 hour planning range, not an instruction to start at an exact hour.
The tool does not give medical or dietetic advice.
details.rounding: Daily and window totals are rounded to the nearest whole gram. The final values are computed from the unrounded daily range before rounding the window total.
